attacks.name: Stars and Stripes Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |!block| |*Flurry|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Stars and Stripes Strike| attack. This additional attack does not have the |*Flurry| special rule.

attacks.name: I Don‘t Like Bullies
steps: |!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Language!|: After the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

superPowers.name: On Your Left
superPowers.body: Advance this character |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: I've Knocked Out Tyrants Over 200 Times
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its attack dice.

superPowers.name: Vibranium Shield
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and increased from 5 to 7 on Injured side.
"On Your Left" no longer requires the character to not be holding an objective token.
"I've Knocked Out Tyrants Over 200 Times" is no longer restricted to once per turn.
